maria (runtime): Heads-up — prod tail p95/p99 for llama-13b-quant jumped ~30% starting 10:12 UTC. Users on eu-west seeing spikes. :eyes:
perf-bot: [ALERT] p99_token_latency increased for model=llama-13b-quant route=/chat/stream region=eu-west at 2024-06-05T10:12:05Z
alex (platform): any recent kernel selector or execution change rolled to prod this morning?
jenna (ml): I merged the kernel-autoselect PR last night (optimize gemm path fallback). It should be on canary then full roll by 03:00 UTC. Changed threshold from 1024->2048 sequence heuristic.
maria (runtime): linking profiling trace from a few failing requests (p99 sample). see snippet:```profile
token_stage: batch_wait=12ms kv_lookup=3ms kernel_dispatch=28ms compute=210ms kv_store=1ms network_send=6ms
cpu_util=18% gpu_util=92% batch_size=1
```
sam (sre): batch_size=1 on p99 is suspicious — looks like batching heuristics aren't coalescing short-latency sessions. Could be new kernel fallback preventing concurrency.
alex (platform): kernel-autoselect change moved some model shards to slower int8 kernel when seq_len>1024. But why batch_size=1? batching window is 5ms default, maybe queue flush triggered by KV blocking?
jenna (ml): KV cache path in runtime recently had a lock introduced to avoid stale-prefetch races. That lock holds during kernel selection decision. If KV lookup blocks dispatch, small batches could be flushed prematurely.
maria (runtime): reproduced locally with synthetic traffic. When KV cache miss rate >15% we see batch flush frequency increase. Attached small trace:```log
[0.000] recv request
[0.004] enqueue
[0.009] kv_lookup start
[0.020] kv_lookup miss -> fetch from remote (12ms)
[0.032] kernel_select (takes 2ms)
[0.034] dispatch -> batch flush
[0.036] compute start
```
alex (platform): ok — two orthogonal issues: (1) kernel selection path is slightly slower due to extra checks (2ms) and sometimes chooses slower kernel, (2) KV miss remote fetchs add ~12ms and are blocking per-request. Both push batch windows to expire.
jenna (ml): quick mitigation: revert threshold change in kernel-autoselect and backport a non-blocking KV lookup (async prefetch) to reduce blocking.
sam (sre): we should also add token-level latency breakdowns to dashboards so on-call can triage faster. Current dashboards only show request-level p95/p99. Need per-route stage KPIs: batch_wait_ms, kv_ms, select_ms, compute_ms, network_ms.
maria (runtime): Agreed. Proposed query for metrics ingestion pipeline and Grafana naming:```sql
-- per-token stage counters emitted by runtime
SELECT route, model, region, percentile(batch_wait_ms, 50,95,99) as batch_wait_pcts,
percentile(kv_ms, 50,95,99) as kv_pcts, percentile(select_ms,50,95,99) as select_pcts
FROM token_stage_metrics
WHERE window = 1m GROUP BY route, model, region
```
alex (platform): we can add those metrics at ingest point (edge proxy) and enrich with routing tags. Also add per-route failover_rate and cross_region_latency: `failover_rate = failed_requests_routed_elsewhere / total_routes`
jenna (ml): for perf regression root cause we should compare kernel selection histograms pre/post deploy and kv_miss_rate over same window. I can produce a diff report.
maria (runtime): action items:
- jenna: roll back kernel-autoselect threshold and cut canary rollback (OWNER: jenna) — ETA 30m
- alex: add token_stage metrics to ingest pipeline + Grafana panels (OWNER: alex) — ETA 3d
- sam: create alert on batch_size_distribution p99>1 and batch_wait_p95>20ms (OWNER: sam) — ETA 2h
- maria: prototype async KV prefetch (POC branch) and link perf traces (OWNER: maria) — ETA EOD

sam (sre): logging suggestion — include `routing_decision` and `route_fallback` tags on each request so we can correlate cross-region failovers. Also add `kernel_variant` tag.
alex (platform): noted. We'll also add a heatmap panel: x-axis=region_src, y-axis=region_dst, value=cross_region_latency_p99.
jenna (ml): I'll run BLAME-style perf diff comparing last 7 deploys and output top contributing changes (kernel selector, kv sync change, batching commit).
maria (runtime): thanks team. I'll post repro script and perf traces in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
